summary: Reverted a previous misplacement of the agent-journal skill into the gizmo repo's workspace packages, then rebuilt it correctly as a linked extension in the gizmo-skills-registry following the pstack convention (index.ts + pi-extension.ts + skills/). Scaffolded the extension directory, wrote a zero-dependency Node script (backfill-journal.mjs) and SKILL.md, registered it in gizmo.registry.json, and added it to the registry's linked list in installed.json so symlinks are preserved on refresh.
decisions: Skills ship via gizmo-skills-registry, not as workspace packages in the gizmo monorepo — the registry is the distribution mechanism and was already the convention (pstack, matt-pocock-skills).
Extension layout matches pstack: extensions/<id>/{index.ts, pi-extension.ts, skills/<skill>/...} with index.ts re-exporting from pi-extension.ts and a no-op Pi factory exposing only {id, name}.
The skill is shipped disabled (installed but not enabled globally) so it must be turned on per project — silently enabling a shipped skill would be wrong.
Skills registry sync-upstreams.mjs only touches entries listed in upstream-lock.json, so adding an unlisted extension there is safe from automated pruning.

Committed the registry change directly to main (not a branch) because this clone is live infrastructure with installed.json pinning to a commit on main, and a side branch wouldn't reproduce on a fresh clone.
Stopped at commit on user instruction — did not push to mcread29/gizmo-skills-registry, so the change remains local-only.
